subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Which open candidate fix should carry the boundary-preservation change for this issue?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but two mergeable closing PRs implement overlapping fixes, and the final in-band-separator versus explicit-boundary shape needs maintainer selection before the issue closes.

options.title: Review and land one candidate
options.body: Choose the cleaner of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94216 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94247, ensure the coalescer seam is covered, and let the merge close this issue.

options.title: Ask for consolidation
options.body: Have the contributors or a maintainer combine the best parts into one branch if neither PR is the desired landing vehicle as-is.

options.title: Keep as design work
options.body: If maintainers prefer explicit boundary metadata instead of carrying separators in-band, close or pause the candidate PRs and keep this issue as the canonical design thread.

recommendation.title: Review and land one candidate
recommendation.body: Choose the cleaner of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94216 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94247, ensure the coalescer seam is covered, and let the merge close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main history and blame put the current embedded chunker/coalescer files on this contributor's refactor path, making them the best available routing owner for the immediate choice.
